normal_initialization_assumption: Normal registered item getters and native RValue/array bindings.
limits: Static item definitions only; effective runtime levels are not inferred.
Only the explicit paired stat IDs are joined, with exactly one selector and level operand per record.
A ranged skill selector remains a random skill, without inventing its rolled identity.
Relic rank vectors retain every ordinal; they are not converted into random ranges.
Talent identities require the independently validated native insertion-key catalogue.
